en: The postcard is a sepia-toned image featuring an old stone castle with several towers, situated beside a river or a large body of water. On the right, there is a printed greeting in Croatian ('Pozdrav iz Siska!') and handwritten cursive text covering much of the right side and bottom. At the bottom left it is labeled '(STARI GRAD)' which means 'old town' or 'old castle' in Croatian, and also features the print 'Dujak, Sisak.'
